credits.title: Enam Batang
credits.overview: Arya and Niken are a happily married couple. Their life is fine. Until one day, Arya attends his college reunion with Niken, and meets Maia, Arya's manta. Since then, things have not been the same anymore.

credits.title: Revan & Reina
credits.overview: Revan has been friends with Reina since childhood. Now, romance sparks between them. But, Revan knows that Reina is still thinking about another guy, Fabian. After three years, Fabian is back into Reinas life. Meanwhile, another girl, Dira, secretly loves Revan. What will happen to Revan, Reina, and Fabian?
